description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2011 World Championships, a deck unlike any other there that surprised everyone and lost only the final, to the Twinboar deck. Built to react to its opponent, it uses Pichu to start evolving, Vileplume to lock out Item cards, Reuniclus to move damage counters and Blissey to heal them, with Donphan, Zekrom and Suicune & Entei LEGEND to attack. The 2011 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, from 12 to 14 August 2011, with more than 400 card and video game players from over 27 countries.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2011 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
